C0690.title: Merchant Penalized by Platform for Dropshipping Without Inventory, Fabricated Invoices to Prove Fake Transactions Result in Real Court Fine
C0690.summary: A trading company operated on an e-commerce platform without its own inventory, purchasing goods from other platforms after consumers placed orders. After the platform penalized it for inflated prices, the company issued 70 false invoices and forged contracts in litigation to prove it had supply and tried to overturn the platform penalty. The court found that it operated without inventory and forged evidence to obstruct trial, rejected all claims, and imposed fines and other judicial sanctions according to law.
